themes.name: Figure shrunk to fit the placement, so its text gets too small
Wrapped into columns: the reading order snakes, long connectors run between columns
ER relations: no crow's feet, cardinality only as text, some relations without arrowheads
Arrows share a trunk, merge or overlap
Wasted space: the figure is too wide or sparse for its content
Default text too small or too pale at full size
Mermaid input dropped: second lines flattened, cylinders, classDef colours
Sequence: a USER tag over 'User' instead of an actor icon; participants not repeated at the bottom
Long detours: loop-backs and skips routed far around the figure
Edge labels float away from their arrows or are crossed by lines

causes.name: The figure's size ignores where it goes: wide or wrapped figures shrink in a page or column
ER drawing: plain arrowheads and '1:N' text instead of crow's feet, missing arrowheads, doubled labels
Arrows that share a trunk or merge (arch fan-outs, wrapped flows)
Small, pale default text (sequence messages, subtitles) even at full size

No colour coding by node kind; Mermaid input dropped (
second lines, cylinders, classDef colours)
Sequence chrome: USER tag instead of an actor icon, no participant row at the bottom
Edge labels float away from their arrows or are crossed by them
Other: legend clutter, unnumbered steps, nothing matched
